title: F pilot failure and corrected commissioning inspection
summary: A MAC was passed as a route lookup key; after symbolic-route repair, a non-QFXTP response caused XTP_FRAME_INVALID. A missing grid-controller grant reproduces plaintext PEER_NOT_TRUSTED, but this precise cause on F is not yet proven.
invariants: Never turn plaintext UNAUTHENTICATED into authenticated success.
Inspect the exact running guest initramfs and its grant; a staged tree is not evidence of guest code.
Keep F/H working FAST, envelope, registration and heartbeat fixes; merge RTO2 branch additively.
Do not replace working guest images without isolated qualification and rollback.
Keep failure diagnosis redacted; never print raw keys or arbitrary unauthenticated payloads.

provenance.claim: Reproduced error mechanism, actual live cause unverified
